# Let Me Teach You AI

> Beginner-focused AI education built around real outcomes, practical workflows, and things people can actually ship.

Canonical site: https://www.letmeteachyouai.com/

## Primary topics

- Learning AI by building practical projects
- AI workflows and automation
- Safe, controlled AI agents
- AI-made landing pages and digital products
- Prompting and beginner-friendly AI use
- Building and operating AI-powered businesses

## Editorial principles

Content should be practical, beginner-friendly, specific, and grounded in something the reader can build or test. Avoid hype, invented results, and unsupported claims.
